title: Pricing approval gateway and enterprise discount guidelines
creator: Marco Ruiz
description: Define and implement an internal 'Approval Gateway' for enterprise pricing changes (pricebook edits, one-off discounts >15%, contract amendments tied to security questionnaire concessions). This ticket captures the workflow, role-based approval matrix, audit trail requirements, tooling updates (Salesforce price schedules, ERP upload), and communications for the rollout. Goal: reduce unreviewed discount exposure, ensure security/compliance sign-off for concessions tied to PQ/SSQ items, and make pricebook changes traceable and reversible.
acceptance_criteria: Approval Gateway documented and signed off by Finance, Legal, Security, and GTM leadership
Automated email notification & audit entry created for every pricebook change or discount > 15%
Salesforce discount approval flow implemented: quoting blocked until approvals are recorded
Pricebook versioning process defined with rollback steps and a validated conversion script for ERP import
Runbook for responding to emergency discount/contract requests (SRE/Legal contacts & SLA) documented
tasks: Draft approval matrix (roles + thresholds) — PM to propose, Finance to validate
Prototype 'Approval Gateway' spec for SFCP (Salesforce CPQ) — engage Sales Ops
Add audit columns and immutable changelog to pricebook spreadsheet (Drive) and create import/export mapping
Work with Security to define which SSQ responses require explicit sign-off before discounting
Legal to review and provide required contract language for concession clauses
Implement notification templates (email + Slack) for approvals/denials
Prepare training deck and two 30-minute training sessions for Sales + AE managers
Create metrics dashboard to track approvals, time-to-approve, and write-offs post-approval
